verdict.rationale: Gusto Business Compliance documents Proactive Compliance Alerts that notify customers of upcoming compliance deadlines and new obligations, including annual reports and annual tax reminders. It also lists proactive deadline alerts alongside annual and initial report filing, which covers the reminder half of the story. Nothing describes a calendar or list view where a legal-ops lead can see all upcoming filing deadlines in one place, and the alerts appear only in press-release and marketing copy. Missing for 10: a documented compliance calendar or deadline-overview view, detail on reminder timing, lead time and channels, and independent or hands-on confirmation of the alerts.
